say:1:1211034001:0.text: Now we have all three keys. I wonder what kind of treasure we'll find. What are you all hoping for?
say:1:1211034001:0.source_cn: 三把钥匙齐活啦，不知道能获得怎样的宝物，你们几个都想要...

say:3:1211034002:1.text: What I want, no one can give me.
say:3:1211034002:1.source_cn: 我想要的东西，神明不可能给我。

say:5:1211034003:0.text: I want to be with my sister forever, but I already have that.
say:5:1211034003:0.source_cn: 我想和姐姐永远在一起，但我已经得到了！

say:9:1211034005:0.text: Chippy doesn't have anything he wants. Chippy just wants the magister to get his memories and powers back.
say:9:1211034005:0.source_cn: 我没什么想要的，我只想主人找回属于自己的记忆和力量。
say:9:1211034005:0.male: Chippy doesn't have anything he wants. Chippy just wants the magister to get his memories and powers back.
say:9:1211034005:0.female: Chippy doesn't have anything he wants. Chippy just wants the magister to get her memories and powers back.

say:13:1211034008:1.male: Because this makes my wish seem very selfish. I just want to be Merlin's most beloved familiar.
say:13:1211034008:1.female: Because this makes my wish seem very selfish. I just want to be Merlin's most beloved familiar.

choice_prompt:15:1211034010.text: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!
choice_prompt:15:1211034010.male: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!
choice_prompt:15:1211034010.female: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!

say:16:1211034010:0.text: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!
say:16:1211034010:0.source_cn: 我懂，最好是堆积如山的黄金！
say:16:1211034010:0.male: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!
say:16:1211034010:0.female: I understand that. I want a mountain of gold!

say:18:1211034013:0.text: We should go back to the island where we started and put the keys back on the stone tablet.
say:18:1211034013:0.source_cn: 接下来，是不是该回到一开始的小岛，将石板放回石碑上？

say:19:1211034014:0.text: That's right. We need the boat. It's anchored next to the treasure chest that was a trap before. Let's go.
say:19:1211034014:0.source_cn: 没错，要回去的话得坐船，船还停在陷阱宝箱那里。走吧！

say:21:1211034011:0.text: Power and strength? Those are nice, I guess, but a bit boring.
say:21:1211034011:0.source_cn: 力量……和权力？那些是不错，但是没意思。
say:21:1211034011:0.male: Power and strength? Those are nice, I guess, but a bit boring.
say:21:1211034011:0.female: Power and strength? Those are nice, I guess, but a bit boring.

say:22:1211034012:0.text: Just hold on a little bit longer. We get the treasure, and then we'll head right back to Rustport.
